name: Trackunit IrisX
description: Query your fleet data in IrisX using natural language, without navigating Trackunit Manager. Review asset status, upcoming services and site activity. Identify active faults and underutilised assets, create alerts and access keys, update asset data, and set up automations and recurring reports.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trackunit IrisX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trackunit IrisX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trackunit.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trackunit IrisX MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trackunit IrisX lists 23 MCP tools, including alerts_create, asset_update, custom-fields_create_or_update_value, custom-fields_delete_value, customer_create, digital-key_change_access_keys, digital-key_create_access_keys, digital-key_delete_access_keys, eventlog_dismiss_asset_events, explore_execute_gql_query, explore_get_manager_urls, and explore_introspect_gql_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trackunit IrisX?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trackunit IrisX in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Trackunit IrisX MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trackunit IrisX requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trackunit IrisX is developed by Trackunit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
